description: pozzi e piezometri di Città metropolitana di Milano - CMMi 002 is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by decimetro.cittametropolitana.mi.it. The service provides georeference of wells and piezometers of Metropolitan City of Milan. The data available are the data collected by the Metropolitan City of Milan through its authorization functions integrated by the SIPIUI portal of the Lombardy Region at regular intervals. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Wells and piezometers of the Metropolitan City of Milan - CMMi 002" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include opendata. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
